result.title: BetaMem: Learning to Remember a Changing World for Embodied Agents
result.summary: Long-horizon embodied agents face temporal confusion and incomplete or distorted records, recurring errors from fixed memory rules, and growing storage and retrieval costs. We present BetaMem, a framework for building and evolving traceable long-term memory through six linked layers: working, spatial, entity, episodic, experiential, and procedural memory. A dual-level write contract constrains operation executability and source support for content: supervised fine-tuning learns compliant memory operations, while reinforcement learning combines repeated sampling with teacher verification of the original observations to reward complete, accurate records and penalize omissions, distortion, and unsupported content. We formulate failure-driven policy recursive self-improvement through diagnosis along the causal sequence of memory operations and local rule repairs gated by independent replay. Atomic tools frame storage, updates, retrieval, and forgetting as cost-utility allocation under storage and read budgets. Using the open-source Qwen3.5-9B model for memory generation, BetaMem achieves overall scores of 48.08% on M3-Bench-robot, 92.08% on LoCoMo, 72.6% on OpenEQA EM-EQA, and 62.4% on EgoLifeQA, the highest among the listed memory methods under their respective evaluation protocols. Training the model for memory generation raises the contract pass rate from 50.9% to 86.2% while reducing output tokens per stored action by 47.3%. A separate Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct evaluation on EMem-Bench achieves an average success rate of 38.4% and an average error recurrence rate of 24.9%. We perform best among evaluated methods using comparably sized open-source models. Category results show that we have advantages in integrating information across observations, recalling events over long histories, and inferring personal habits.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 BetaMem，用工作、空间、实体、情节、经验与程序六层记忆为具身智能体构建并演化可追溯的长期记忆，并以监督微调加强化学习（由教师对原始观测进行校验）训练合规的记忆写入操作。
AI.relevance_reason: 其将存储、更新、检索与遗忘形式化为预算约束下的成本—效用分配，并用原始观测校验的奖励惩罚遗漏与失真，可能为 LVR 的停止决策、视觉证据筛选与 latent 状态更新监督提供可核查线索，迁移可行性尚待确认。
